evidence.curator_note: Left column of Equation 8.82, vertical arrow labelled 'a | -RCHO': the SAME alkoxy-radical / protonated-ester ion cleaves the other bond at the carbinol carbon, expelling the whole R-CHO aldehyde as a stable neutral (p.197: 'because of the high stability of the resulting neutral product RCHO') and leaving the drawn distonic ion .CH2-(CH2)n-1-C(=O)-O(+)(H)CH3, whose primary radical is printed as 'H2C.' at the far end of the chain. Book draws 2 arc(s) for this branch, both single-barb fishhooks: (i) the SOLID hook from the radical dot on O(9) into the C(7)-O(9) bond, which the panel shares with the competing '-R.' branch (encoded as move <1>), and (ii) the DASHED hook from the C(7)-C(6) bond into the C(7)-O(9) bond (move <2>) -- the book dashes it to mark it as the alternative of the two branches leaving this panel. Move <3>, the hook that puts the second C(6)-C(7) electron on C(6) to make the drawn primary radical, is an implicit homolysis hook required for electron balance (not drawn on the page). INSTANTIATION (the scheme is generic in R and in the chain length n): R = CH3 and n = 5, i.e. methyl 7-hydroxyoctanoate CH3-CH(OH)-(CH2)5-C(=O)-OCH3 (C9H18O3, M+. m/z 174.1250). n = 5 is the smallest chain that makes the final 'rH, a' step of this same scheme proceed through the favoured six-membered transition state, and it keeps the book's (CH2)n-3 label meaningful ((CH2)2). NO m/z and NO percentage is printed anywhere in Equation 8.82 except 'm/z 55' on the last product; every other mass in these records is the curator's computed monoisotopic value for this instantiation, not a measured number.

rule_index.json 'by_equation' has NO entry for 8.82 (the index stops at 8.14 for Chapter 8), so no MOD rule is cross-linked to this record. Same negative result as 8.82d: IMS_4_9 / IMS_4_13_1 are the only generic saturated-site alpha cleavages in the index and both demand that the odd electron sit on the CHARGED site, while this cleavage is driven by a neutral alkoxy radical with the charge held on a remote oxonium; IMS_4_9 additionally cleaves a bond not incident to the pi-forming atom and does not conserve spin. Unmodelled.
